limits.detail: Allowlists prove which fields are copied, not whether author-selected public prose contains spoilers. Actual authored-pack privacy, tone, continuity, production counts and playability require separate content/integration review.

A syntactically valid Ed25519 public key and Scope do not authenticate the caller, establish key ownership, grant campaign rights or prove perception/consent. This pure host-only initialization API claims none of those.
CampaignSeed contains genesis privateSeed and host-only variant/manifest; it must remain host/referee data. Only whitelisted public extractors are appropriate for player delivery.
The catalog creates DTOs only. Tests do not establish runtime ledger adoption, character configuration or world behavior, and no new engine expansion was reviewed.
Only the immutable catalog candidate and frozen interfaces were reviewed; actual content and rules calculator lanes remain separate.
